verdict.rationale: Clerk documents default admin/member Roles plus custom Roles and fine-grained Permissions. It says the Organization context, including memberships, Roles and the Active Organization, is provided in each session, and its session token is a JWT carrying user and session information. Permission-gating of calls is shown for eve tool calls. A community user notes that roles are scoped to Organizations, so a global admin requires metadata workarounds; this narrows the model but does not contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the exact role/permission claims inside the JWT, general-purpose server-side enforcement helpers beyond eve tool calls, app-level (non-organization) roles, and independent hands-on corroboration.
